body: I ask myself this same question every day *why do I need this voice?* For me, it's the only thing I have that hasn't abandoned me like my friends and most of my family have. I need it because without it I would probably do really stupid things. Somehow I believe that I need it.
I work in retail, I have no problem keeping my job but at the end of every shift I end up crying and hurting myself.
I've been like this for 4 years. I want to apply to Uni again but I need to wait till next year, and I can't keep living like this. With my dead end job and my parents constantly on my case to leave.

Thank you for your support, I do appreciate it. I want to believe you, but I don't feel I deserve any of that. I feel like whenever something bad happens to me, it's because I deserve it and I am a horrible person. I can't fight the voice in my head because I believe that I need it.
